# [ENTITY NAME]

> [ENTITY NAME] is an attorney-led platform that partners with elder law, estate planning and probate firms in the New York metro area and northern New Jersey.

[ENTITY NAME] works with owner-operators of elder law, estate planning, and probate and trust administration firms on Long Island, in Westchester, in the five boroughs and in northern New Jersey, typically with roughly $750K–$3M in revenue and one to five attorneys. Owners choose one of two paths: partner and keep practicing (sell a minority stake for liquidity, keep running the practice, hand marketing, intake, administration and technology to a services team, and hold equity in the platform), or retire on their own timeline (a purchase structured under the professional rules on the sale of a law practice, staff kept, a structured handoff). Firms stay owned by attorneys. Conversations are confidential and covered by an NDA before any details are shared. [ENTITY NAME] LLC is not a law firm and does not provide legal services. The firms we work with are independently owned and operated by licensed attorneys. Contact: [CONTACT EMAIL]
